name: io.github.markmnl/fmsg-mcp
title: fmsg
description: Federated messaging with your fmsg hosting provider. Connect with OAuth or an API key.

environmentVariables.name: FMSG_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your hosting provider's or self-hosted fmsg Web API

environmentVariables.name: FMSG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: fmsg API key (fmsgk_...) for the address to send as

environmentVariables.name: FMSG_DEFAULT_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: lets short names resolve to @name@<domain>

environmentVariables.name: FMSG_MCP_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional local folder enabling streamed attachment saves over stdio

oauth_mcp_endpoint.description: OAuth MCP endpoint from your fmsg hosting provider: hostname and path without https://. Sign in through your AI host; no API key needed.

api_key_mcp_endpoint.description: API-key MCP endpoint from your fmsg hosting provider: hostname and path without https://. Use an endpoint that accepts your key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your fmsg API key for the selected MCP endpoint

api_key.description: API key accepted by this endpoint's fmsg Web API, starting with fmsgk_
